summary: recordPrices and recordOffers return early when REWE_NO_LOCAL_DATA=1, so searches and offers fetches never write product prices to the local SQLite store after the user opts out.
reason: products search was changed to record price snapshots, and with REWE_NO_LOCAL_DATA=1 that path still opened the local store and wrote names and prices. Guarding inside the recorders makes every caller respect the opt-out. Covered by TestRecordPricesHonoursLocalDataOptOut.
